title: Orchestrate PRD handoff dependency lattice and explicit acceptance checklist
creator: Aisha Patel
decisions: Adopt a three-stage clearance ladder: Legal (data residency & export) -> Design (UX + accessibility) -> Engineering (SLOs, telemetry, rollouts)
Enforce 48-hour review turnaround for each owner; escalation path to PM lead after 72 hours
Require a synthetic end-to-end test harness and a telemetry spec before signoff
Rollout fallback: automatic degrade to latest-stable model + route to Dedicated capacity if latency regression > 25%
acceptance_criteria: Confluence acceptance checklist completed and signed by Legal, Design, and Eng leads
Design mockups (high-fidelity) uploaded to Drive + accessibility audit summary attached
Engineering runbook for private deployment (upgrade, rollback, migrations) published
Telemetry spec includes token-level cost, per-route latency p50/p95, error rate thresholds and alert targets
A GitHub PR with integration tests and a staging deployment exists and passes the synthetic harness
Dependencies listed above resolved or an explicit mitigation plan documented in Confluence
description:
Purpose: Coordinate a reproducible, low-friction PRD review + acceptance path for features that span Private deployment, runtime changes (KV cache/batching), and structured-output UX. This ticket defines owners, cadence, explicit checks, and escalation lanes so future PRDs can be cleared with predictable SLAs.

Context: The product change we are prepping touches telemetry schema, model pinning semantics, and a UX decision for exposing structured outputs in the Console. Past signoffs have stalled because Legal and Design were not engaged early and there were mismatched expectations about rollout fallbacks. This ticket unblocks that by codifying the clearance lattice and producing a checklist artifact.

Progress notes and timeline:
- 2026-02-24: Kickoff meeting with Legal (Nadia Chen), Design (Marco Alvarez), Eng leads (Priya Rao). Agreed on 48h review target and single Confluence checklist as the canonical source. Action: PM to draft checklist.
- 2026-02-26: Draft checklist posted to Confluence. Design requested clarity on where structured-output examples live; created DES-342 (sub-issue) to finalize mockups.
- 2026-03-03: Eng requested telemetry schema versioning guidance; assigned ENG-59821 to runtime infra for schema gating.
- 2026-03-08: Legal flagged data residency edge cases for on-prem installs; requested explicit KMS/HSM encryption details and export-control notes. Legal signoff gated on a short appendix.
- 2026-03-12: PM review with leads — checklist updated, acceptance_criteria enumerated, synthetic harness template added.
- 2026-03-15: Current — In Progress. Awaiting Design final mocks (DES-342), and ENG-59821 infra changes in staging. Next: schedule 30-min clearance window on 2026-03-18 to collect signoffs.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal: Is the appendix language for data residency acceptable for APAC partner deployments? (Nadia working w/ partner legal; ETA 2026-03-17)
- Design: Need final microcopy for structured-output error states; blocker for final UX signoff (Marco).
- Eng: Synthetics harness currently runs only on hosted infra; need a staging configuration for Dedicated/private testing (ENG-59821).

Follow-ups assigned:
- PM (Lena): coordinate clearance window, collate signatures in Confluence, update rollout plan with fallback lanes.
- Design (Marco): upload final mocks and accessibility checklist to Drive by 2026-03-17.
- Legal (Nadia): finalize data residency appendix; confirm export-control mitigations by 2026-03-17.
- Eng (Priya): complete ENG-59821 and provide staging config for synthetic harness by 2026-03-20.

Acceptance workflow (how to use this ticket):
1) Owner (PM) ensures checklist is complete and all artifact links present.
2) Legal, Design, Eng leads review and post either APPROVE / REQUEST CHANGES in the Confluence checklist comments.
3) If any owner REQUESTS CHANGES, the assignee creates follow-up sub-issue(s) and marks the checklist incomplete.
4) When all APPROVE, PM triggers a quick ‘clearance note’ and attaches signatures to the PRD document and the release notes.

Artifacts to attach to the PRD at signoff: Confluence checklist URL, Drive mockups folder, GitHub PR number, staging synthetic harness run URL, telemetry schema doc, and Legal appendix.

Expected outcome: A repeatable, time-boxed clearance pattern that reduces signoff time and prevents late-scope surprises during rollout.
